name: Siege Engine: Dragon Ballista
body:
Cost: 750 gp
Damage: 3d8
Critical: 19-20
Range Increment: 200 ft.
Typical Crew 1

A dragon ballista resembles a small cannon more than a ballista. It uses a gunpowder charge to fire a ballista bolt. It functions exactly like a ballista, but it is much easier to load, requiring only a single full-round action, regardless of size.

A single shot from a dragon ballista costs 1 gp.

A dragon ballista takes up a space 5 feet across.
